label: Interactions for a Particular Data Node
description: Finds all interactions (wp:Interaction) connected to a particular data node, here the Ensembl gene ENSG00000125845.
query:
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX wp: <http://vocabularies.wikipathways.org/wp#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?interaction ?pathway WHERE {
   ?pathway a wp:Pathway .
   ?interaction dcterms:isPartOf ?pathway .
   ?interaction a wp:Interaction .
   ?interaction wp:participants <https://identifiers.org/ensembl/ENSG00000125845> .
}
